newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZCC clears Mainland to buy some Kiwi assets.
newsitem.headline: NZCC clears Mainland to buy some Kiwi assets.

text.p: New Zealand's anti-monopolies Commerce Commission on Tuesday cleared Mainland Products Ltd to acquire some of the assets of Kiwi Co-operative Dairies Ltd and 100 percent of the shares of two Kiwi subsidiaries.
The commission said it was satisfied that the proposal would not result in Mainland acquiring or strengthening a dominant position in any market.

Its greatest market share would be 48.5 percent in the market for wholesale supply of natural cheese, where it would still face strong competition from New Zealand Co-operative Dairy Company with 31 percent. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734
